home.title: Home

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your account and, for administrators, the application configuration, users and audit trail.

account.title: My account
account.description: These preferences are stored with your account and follow you on any computer.

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Functional settings of the application. Every change is applied at once and recorded in the audit trail.
config.infraDescription: Set by IT in the server environment. Read-only here; secrets are masked.

users.title: Users
users.description: Accounts that can sign in. New users receive a temporary password and must change it when they first sign in.
users.tempIntro: Give this password to {{email}}. It is shown only once; the user must change it at first sign-in.
users.deleteBody: This removes {{email}} for good. The audit trail keeps the record of what this user did. Type the email to confirm.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Who did what and when. Passwords and tokens are never recorded.
